name: smwgraphics-actraiser-marahna-act
title: ActRaiser - Marahna (Act 2 ~ Boss Room)
description:
The background seen in the Act 2 of Marahna, from ActRaiser. Adapted and looped for usage in SMW Hacks. It's very simple to adjust the position of each element. Can be looped vertically too, if needed.

Due to it heavily relying in the black color, I've made it use the back area color.

Good fit for temples or castles, in general.
